description: Main front-end source code for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game, including UI components, game logic, and style definitions, with mode selection and session score tracking.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget setting theme and routing to HomeScreen.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Initial screen allowing mode selection between player vs player and player vs computer.

classes.name: _ModeCard
classes.description: UI component representing mode selection cards with touch animations.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main game screen handling the gameplay, rendering the board, scores, turn indicators, and game state management.

classes.name: _TurnIndicator
classes.description: Displays current turn status, highlighting active player.

classes.name: _PlayerChip
classes.description: Visual indicator for players with animated highlights.

classes.name: _ScoreBar
classes.description: Displays current session scores for X, O, and draws.

classes.name: _Board
classes.description: Creates a interactive 3x3 grid representing the game board.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Individual cell widget with animated response to user taps, displaying X or O.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point initiating the Tic Tac Toe app.

methods.name: _buildTheme
methods.description: Constructs the app theme with color schemes and button styles.

methods.name: _startGame
methods.description: Starts a new game with selected mode from HomeScreen.

methods.name: _onCellTap
methods.description: Handles user tap on a board cell, updates game state, checks for win/draw.

methods.name: _evaluateBoardAndMaybeContinue
methods.description: Checks for game end conditions and triggers dialogs or continues turns.

methods.name: _detectWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner based on current board state.

methods.name: _isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if the game board is completely filled.

methods.name: _showEndDialog
methods.description: Displays end-of-game dialog with options to restart or go home.

methods.name: _makeComputerMove
methods.description: Performs AI move based on a simple heuristic to choose best move.

methods.name: _chooseBestAIMove
methods.description: AI heuristic for selecting the optimal move, prioritizing winning, blocking, center, corners, edges.
